name: Monthly Maintenance — Cowfish
source: KB: 1.3 Cowfish - God Doc / Consumables table + Engine Info table
intro: First of the month maintenance for Cowfish. This checklist supersedes any daily maintenance tasks. Engines are 2024 Suzuki DF115BG (starboard) and DF115BZG (port). Check engine hours and complete any service interval items that are due.

items.label: Tool kit inventory — verify mousing/safety wire, hydraulic fluid and fill tube, emergency oil, fuel filters in spares kit
Inspect zincs (mounting bracket and lower unit) — replace if >50% eroded

help.title: Cowfish zinc part numbers
help.body:
Mounting bracket zinc: 55320-94900
Lower unit zinc: 55321-90J01
Source: 1.3 Cowfish - God Doc, Consumables

help.title: Bilge pump details
help.body: Atwood Sahara MK 2. Available at Cubanito's or special order from West Marine. Installation needs: 3x ring terminal heat shrink connectors AWG 16-22 with #8 ring/hole, Phillips screwdriver. Bonus: dielectric grease. Match black to black, white-stripe to white.

items.label: Inventory consumables and dock box — restock as needed

sections.title: Engine Hour Thresholds — Suzuki DF115BG/BZG
sections.description: If an engine hour quota is reached, these tasks take PRIORITY over weekly maintenance items. Check engine hours and complete any that are due.

items.label: Every 100 hrs: Change engine oil & filter, grease shifter

help.title: 100-hour service — Suzuki DF115BG/BZG
help.body:
Oil: Quicksilver Semi-Synthetic 25W-40, 5.5L per engine
Oil filter: Suzuki 16510-61A31 / Sierra 18-7905-2 (West Marine)

SHIFTER GREASE: Grease the shifter with grease gun at every oil change. Critical to safety — do not skip.
Source: 1.3 Cowfish - God Doc, Consumables

items.label: Every 200 hrs: Replace oil filter, water pump impeller inspection

help.title: 200-hour service — Suzuki DF115BG/BZG
help.body:
Oil filter: Suzuki 16510-61A31 / Sierra 18-7905-2 — replace at 200 hours max
Water pump impeller: Replace every 200 hours or 12 months (whichever comes first). Inspect housing for wear, cracks, or distortion — replace housing if damaged.
Impeller kit number: [NEEDS VERIFICATION — not yet in God Doc]
Lower unit oil: SAE #90 hypoid gear oil or Suzuki gear oil, 1050 ml (37 US imp. oz)
Source: 1.3 Cowfish - God Doc, Consumables

items.label: Every 1000 hrs: Replace high pressure fuel filter (mechanic required)

help.title: 1000-hour service — Suzuki DF115BG/BZG
help.body:
High pressure fuel filter replacement — requires mechanic.
Schedule with your marine mechanic in advance.
Source: 1.3 Cowfish - God Doc, Consumables

items.label: Confirm shifter was greased at last oil change — Critical to safety

help.title: Shifter grease — CRITICAL
help.body:
Grease the shifter with a grease gun at every oil change. This is critical to safety — failure to grease can cause the shifter to seize or malfunction, potentially losing ability to shift in/out of gear.
Source: 1.3 Cowfish - God Doc, Engine oil row note

sections.title: Prop & Drive Reference
sections.description: Visual check during monthly maintenance. Note any damage.

items.label: Inspect props for dings, bends, or fishing line wrap

help.title: Cowfish prop specs
help.body:
Port prop: Suzuki SS 3Lx14x20 — COUNTER ROTATING (left hand spin)
Starboard prop: 3Rx14x21 [NEEDS VERIFICATION — stamps unclear per God Doc]
Source: 1.3 Cowfish - God Doc, Props section
